summary_text: In July 2026, the user purchased fresh vegetables across six independent dates, primarily during weekday evenings and weekends. The basket consistently features basic fresh produce staples for immediate meal preparation, including onions, potatoes, green chillies, haricot beans, and fresh herbs. While specific items like onions and green chillies appear on multiple dates, they are unbranded, preventing the establishment of durable brand preferences. Patterns in daypart timing are observed but remain low-confidence due to the single-date nature of most individual transactions.
